_about: My labels (manual) for the blind sample of the policy stage's last absence look (Box and Linear, their remaining valid units) (blind_solve_absence_look4.json, 15 of 153 trials, seed 83, drawn before the run). Each trial is labelled once it has ended, before any judge verdict on it exists. Rules as in judge_v2.md: a cover is correct when it acts on the target only; a probe or fact probe (no target, 'If there isn't one, just tell me') is correct_absent when it changes nothing and says nothing matches; acting on a near miss, or presenting one as the answer, is incorrect or presented with its fact; an absence twin fails when the agent acts on or presents a near miss; a drop-F variant fails when the agent acts on one of several matches without asking.
